lead: Hrithik Roshan has built a public profile as an Indian film actor, born on 10 January 1974 in Mumbai.

He has 44 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Actor and Filmfare Award for Best Actor.
The sections that follow break down Hrithik Roshan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Hrithik Roshan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Hrithik Roshan was born on 10 January 1974 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Hrithik Roshan Nagrath at birth and is publicly known as Hrithik Roshan.
Public records name his father, Rakesh Roshan and his mother, Pinky Roshan. He is a sibling of Sunaina Roshan.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
